title: Cold-Therapy Unit Take-Home Price List by Dispensing Site — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Take-home price list.** The cold-therapy unit (code E0218 under revenue code 0274) on an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is priced from Riverbend's take-home price list for its dispensing site, never above its charges, reading its billed units and its number of lines from the account's charge postings:

| Dispensing site (campus of the account) | Value |
|---|---|
| Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute | the lesser of its charges and its billed units times 185.00 USD |
| a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah) | the lesser of its charges and its charges times 0.6 plus 12.00 USD for each of its lines |
| otherwise (Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton) | its charges |

**Worked cases (hypothetical)**
- Grand Chute, 1 unit, charges 250.00: lesser of 250.00 and 185.00 → 185.00.
- Neenah, charges 250.00 on 2 lines: 250.00 times 0.6 is 150.00, plus 24.00 → 174.00.
- Appleton, charges 20.00 on 1 line: 12.00 plus 12.00 is 24.00, above the charges → 20.00.
- Chilton, charges 250.00 → 250.00.
